question: In 2021,which financial institution entered into a collaboration with Google India Pvt Ltd (GIPL) for piloting a social impact lending programme with financial assistance up to ₹1 crore at subsidised interest rates?
solution:
The correct answer is __SIDBI__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Small Industries Development Bank of India (Sidbi) has entered into a partnership with Google India Pvt Ltd (GIPL).
 
• It will pilot a social impact lending programme with financial assistance up to ₹1 crore at competitive interest rates to MSMEs.
 
• A loan programme targeted at micro-enterprises with loan sizes ranging between ₹25 lakh to ₹1 crore, is being implemented by SIDBI.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

__
 
• ​This partnership with GIPL brings a corpus of $15 million (around ₹110 crores) to micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) as a crisis response related to Covid-19.
 
• This also marks SIDBI's launch of a paperless journey to its customers from onboarding to the disbursal stage.
 
• The major focus under the programme shall be on enterprises run by women entrepreneurs, with suitable interest rate concession also envisaged for such enterprises.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• ​SIDBI:

 
 
• Headquarters - Lucknow.
 
• Founded On - 2 April 1990.
